text: Kevin Park is the strongest candidate for Santa Clara mayor because he is the only one in this race who championed a Gaza ceasefire resolution on the City Council, a local act that his opponents Karen Hardy and Kathy Watanabe opposed. Park has not called the war a genocide and has not backed blocking weapons transfers, but he was the councilmember who pushed for a ceasefire when the effort was blocked before introduction, and he backed a United Against Hate resolution alongside it. CAIR Action places him at its preferred tier for this race. Hardy and Watanabe both opposed the ceasefire call while supporting only a general anti-hate resolution that shields Israel from local accountability, and Watanabe carries an endorsement from the Korean American Political Association of Northern California, marking her alignment with Israel-friendly interests. Park's record of standing with the Muslim community when the council refused to act makes him the clear choice to carry that accountability into city government.
